last_summary: Best-supported interpretation is that the interior/cabin step shows wrong ordering in v1 and likely v2, because v1 fine evidence places interior work before cabin placement and v2 fine evidence involves grey cabin/interior parts, though v2 join-versus-separate remains ambiguous. v2 baseplate/frame evidence is not enough to establish base/chassis wrong order across two videos, and v3 lacks observed ladder/turntable or cabin/interior ordering.
